reader_summary.overview: My guest today Michael Mayer, is the founder and CEO of Bottomless. Today’s conversation is about tactical lessons Michael has learned while building the business. We talk about identifying an addressable problem, how to avoid solving for bottlenecks that don’t yet exist, and how to iterate through problems before scaling.

key_points.text: My guest today Michael Mayer, is the founder and CEO of Bottomless.
As yet another example of a self-taught entrepreneur, it’s inspiring to hear Michael’s mindset for problem-solving.
I hope you enjoy my conversation with Michael Mayer.
